results.name: Adoption Connection Asheville
results.description: A discussion and support group for the adoption constellation: adoptees, birth and first parents, adoptive parents and the people who love them. Co-facilitated by an adoption-informed therapist and a reunion coach.
results.notes: Search snippet describes monthly group co-facilitated by Leslie Pate McKinnon and Elizabeth Barbour; Eventbrite events match.

results.name: Appalachian Barn Alliance
results.description: A historic preservation group that catalogues and restores the barns of Western North Carolina, especially in Madison County, including the Smith Heritage Farmstead at Bailey Mountain Preserve in Mars Hill.
results.notes: Grey: real preservation nonprofit with annual Barn Day, but our only events are a benefit hosted by A-B Tech. Kept per lenient rule. No official site confirmed.

results.name: Asheville Area Breathwork Meetup
results.description: Breathwork meetup used to promote paid breathwork sessions and group ketamine-assisted psychotherapy programs.
results.notes: Events are paid programs and KAP intake promotions by a practitioner, not a member community.

results.name: Asheville Book Club Meetup
results.description: A casual Asheville book club that picks a title every month or two and meets at a local brewery to discuss it over beers.
results.notes: Meetup group; last event March 2026, organizer mentions moving coordination to WhatsApp.

results.name: Asheville Cuddle Collective
results.description: A community that holds consent-based cuddle and snuggle gatherings, including community, queer platonic and poly/ENM-focused sessions. Attendance is by ticket.
results.notes: Grey: ticketed events, but a large returning community on Meetup (37 events). Kept per lenient rule.

results.name: Asheville GreenWorks
results.description: A local environmental nonprofit whose volunteers pick up litter along waterways, then gather at a local brewery afterward in the Hoppy Water Wednesday series.
results.notes: WLOS coverage confirms the Hoppy Waters Wednesday volunteer program. Website domain is the known GreenWorks site, not verified in results.

results.name: Asheville Insight Meditation
results.description: A Theravada-style insight meditation community with guided sits, dharma talks and Q&A led by founding teacher Ronya Banks. Drop-in, in person at MindSpring or online.
results.schedule: Twice weekly, Thursday evening and Sunday
results.notes: Search confirms Asheville Insight Meditation (AIM) runs this Meetup; ashevillemeditation.com.

results.name: Asheville Psychedelic Preparation and Integration
results.description: A Meetup that has listed a single practitioner-led fire and sound ceremony.
results.notes: One ceremony event hosted by a practitioner at a private home; no evidence of a returning member community.

results.name: Asheville Social Dance
results.description: A social dance club for swing, ballroom and country dancing, with live band dance parties and special shows at a downtown rooftop bar.
results.notes: Meetup events through late Sept 2026 with regulars named in descriptions.

results.name: Asheville Wine & Food Society
results.description: The Asheville chapter of the International Wine & Food Society, a membership group that gathers at local restaurants and bars for tastings and dinners.
results.notes: Meetup key iw-fs suggests IWFS chapter; events are venue outings. Last event Aug 2026.

results.name: AVL International Connections
results.description: A social group that brings internationals, newcomers and locals together for monthly mix-and-mingle evenings, mostly at a riverside brewery.
results.notes: Meetup with monthly mixers through October 2026.

results.name: Black Cat Book Club
results.description: A monthly book club focused on speculative, spooky and genre fiction, meeting at the Botanical Gardens at Asheville and a downtown spot.
results.notes: Meetup with monthly picks (Hill House, Book of Night, etc.) and a future event.

results.name: Candler Dungeons & Dragons Group
results.description: A Candler-area Dungeons & Dragons group for game nights open to experienced players and newcomers.
results.notes: Meetup with one listed event in Nov 2025; no later activity.

results.name: Common Threads in Uncommon Times
results.description: A Sunday morning gathering to sit in silence and share ideas about contemplative spiritual practices, open to many religious and spiritual traditions.
results.notes: Listed weekly on Explore Asheville and Mountain Xpress, last Sept 2026. No independent site found.

results.name: Danzn Guyz & Galz
results.description: A drop-in social ballroom dance group led by a local dancer, with a short lesson in a rotating style each month followed by open dancing.
results.notes: Town of Weaverville listing; led by Renee Twilley since at least 2023 per prior pass.

results.name: Drikung Dharmakirti International Sangha
results.description: A Buddhist sangha following the Drikung Kagyu lineage under Dorje Lopon Dr. Lye. Members commit to weekly gatherings; newcomers are welcomed on the first Wednesday of the month.
results.notes: Urban Dharma founder Hun Lye is the DDIS teacher; separate from Urban Dharma itself, so not a duplicate.

results.name: Families Anonymous
results.description: A 12-step peer support group for relatives and friends affected by someone else's addiction, meeting weekly in Hendersonville.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress listings Dec 2025 to Apr 2026; none since. Part of the national Families Anonymous program.

results.name: Fun Stand Up Paddle Boarding Adventures in WNC
results.description: A stand-up paddleboarding group that organizes easy lake paddles and brewery socials around Western North Carolina.
results.schedule: Seasonal, a few times per season
results.notes: Meetup with two events in spring 2026; seasonal activity.

results.name: Hendo Fun Friends
results.description: A Hendersonville-area social group that organizes outings to local arts, theatre and cultural events.
results.notes: One Meetup event (a Sandburg theatre performance). Near-identical sibling m:https-www-meetup-com-hendo-fun-friends exists; not marked duplicate here since stats for it are unseen.

results.name: In Other Words Writing Group
results.description: A monthly writing group for all genres where members workshop their writing, share ideas and encourage each other.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress listings through Nov 2026, contact email in listing.

results.name: Joyride Improv
results.description: An Asheville improv community that runs free monthly longform improv jams at Story Parlor, plus workshops and showcases for improvisers of all levels.
results.notes: Grey: also sells paid workshops, but free jams draw regular improvisers. Led by Stevie Ramirez, Eric Brown and Nora Tramm. Site likely joyrideimprov.com, unverified.

results.name: Leveller Old Time Jam
results.description: An old-time music jam where local fiddle, banjo and guitar players gather in the taproom to play Appalachian tunes. Players and listeners are welcome.
results.notes: Listed on Mountain Xpress and Explore Asheville; regular jam of local players.

results.name: Match/Books
results.description: A singles event brand that held a ticketed premiere mixer at a bookshop champagne bar.
results.notes: Single promoted event ("Match/Books Premiere"), exclusive limited-spot format; reads as an event promoter.

results.name: Middle Aged and Awesome (Women Only)
results.description: A social group for midlife women that organizes casual outings such as dinner and movie nights.
results.notes: Meetup, one event in Jan 2026. Kept per lenient rule.

results.name: Mynifest your Goal: Achieved Outcomes
results.description: A personal development workshop series built around a trademarked goal-setting method.
results.notes: Two branded workshops by a single practitioner; business storefront rather than a member group.

results.name: Old Farmer's Ball
results.description: A volunteer-run community that hosts contra, English country and family dances with live music and callers. Newcomers and dancers without partners are welcome.
results.home_base: Warren Wilson College and Harvest House, Asheville
results.notes: oldfarmersball.com and CDSS organizer page confirm. Likely main listing for the separate English country and contra dance candidates.

results.name: Pack Memorial Library Teen Dungeons & Dragons
results.description: A free Dungeons & Dragons program for teens ages 13 to 17 at Pack Memorial Library, run by library staff. Registration is by email.
results.notes: Matches the approved library teen D&D sibling: biweekly, same kind of program. Kept per lenient rule.

results.name: Ram Dass Local Asheville Satsang
results.description: A free monthly satsang of readings and discussion inspired by Ram Dass, held in collaboration with the Love Serve Remember Foundation.
results.notes: Listings March to June 2026; none since. No independent site confirmed.

results.name: Sacred Fire Asheville
results.description: A local Sacred Fire Community hamlet that holds community, women's and men's fire circles with a potluck. Free to attend, donations welcome.
results.schedule: Monthly community fire, plus men's/women's fires
results.notes: Search confirms sacredfireasheville.org and chapter in WNC; site URL inferred from search text.

results.name: Single and Social in Asheville
results.description: A social group for singles, mostly in their 30s and 40s but open to all, that hosts weekly board game nights at Archetype Brewing and other socials.
results.notes: Meetup group with 2,500+ members per earlier pass.

results.name: Sovereign Kava Open Jam
results.description: A weekly Tuesday night jam for experienced musicians at a kava bar, built around a house band with players sitting in. Sign-up is at 7:30 PM.
results.notes: Grey: venue-hosted jam, but the same experienced players return. Website is the venue site.

results.name: Swannanoa Community Grief Threads Project
results.description: A community embroidery circle in which neighbors stitch a shared quilt to work through loss after Hurricane Helene. No experience needed.
results.schedule: Twice monthly in the winter series
results.notes: AVL Today listings Jan to Apr 2026 hosted by Swannanoa community center; series appears to have ended.

results.name: The Connect
results.description: A weekly community jam curated by Women to the Front for musicians of all levels, in a welcoming and intergenerational setting.
results.home_base: The One Stop, Asheville Music Hall
results.notes: Started Aug 2026; weekly jam. Grey: venue-hosted but run by a named collective.

results.name: True Colors Circle
results.description: A free coffee and conversation circle for LGBTQIA2S+ adults age 50 and over, focused on connection, peer support and local resources.
results.notes: Sponsored by AmeriHealth Caritas, so partly an insurer program; kept as an age-based LGBTQ+ social group per lenient rule.

results.name: Weaverville Community Center Genealogy Group
results.description: A monthly group where family history enthusiasts share research methods, records and tips for tracing their ancestry.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress listings through Nov 2026.

results.name: When the Old No Longer Fits
results.description: A small supportive circle for women navigating life transitions, with quiet sharing and encouragement.
results.notes: Grey: two Eventbrite listings (Feb and Mar 2026), likely facilitator-led. Kept per lenient rule.

results.name: WNC Repair Cafe
results.description: A volunteer-led group of repair coaches that fixes household items, clothing and small appliances for free at pop-up events across Western North Carolina.
results.home_base: Asheville Tool Library and area libraries
results.notes: Search confirms free volunteer-run events since 2018 and a 2026 calendar.

results.name: Yeru Asheville
results.description: A local practice group of the Yeru Bon Center that meets monthly for Bon Buddhist meditation, chanting and study, with tea and conversation.
results.notes: Search confirms Yeru Asheville under Latri Nyima Dakpa Rinpoche; Meetup events through Oct 2026.
